mapper.select: SELECT S.SETTLE_NO, S.SETTLE_DT, S.SETTLE_AMT, SL.SELLER_NM FROM TB_SETTLE S JOIN TB_SELLER SL ON S.SELLER_ID = SL.SELLER_ID
SELECT I.*, O.ORDER_DT FROM TB_SETTLE_ITEM I JOIN TB_ORDER O ON I.ORDER_NO = O.ORDER_NO WHERE I.SETTLE_NO = #{settleNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_SETTLE SET SETTLE_STAT_CD = #{settleStatCd} WHERE SETTLE_NO = #{settleNo}
mapper.select: SELECT SELLER_ID, SELLER_NM, BIZ_NO FROM TB_SELLER
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_SELLER (SELLER_ID, SELLER_NM, BIZ_NO) VALUES (#{sellerId}, #{sellerNm}, #{bizNo})
mapper.select: SELECT YM, SELLER_ID, SALES_AMT FROM TB_SALES_MONTHLY WHERE YM = #{ym}
